retrieval.rag_summary:
ProctorGeo Vap represents a specialized vapour-retardant
geotextile or composite drainage membrane within the Proctor civil and building
envelope line. Engineered for subterranean, under-slab, and basement foundation
applications, it combines drainage filtration with moisture vapour control to
block ground dampness from migrating into structural building elements. It
prevents damp concrete slabs, efflorescence, and moisture-induced flooring
failures.
